name: The Ritz-Carlton, Washington D.C.
insider_take: This legendary luxury hotel sits just two blocks from the White House, making it the unofficial headquarters for dignitaries, power brokers, and discerning travelers seeking Washington's most prestigious address.
whats_special: The Ritz-Carlton Washington D.C. occupies a historic 1920s neoclassical building and has hosted every U.S. President since its opening. The hotel's Club Level was specifically designed with soundproof meeting spaces, as it's frequently used for sensitive diplomatic discussions. The property features original Waterford crystal chandeliers and houses one of the city's most exclusive cigar lounges.
pro_tip: Book a Potomac River view room on floors 8-10 for stunning vistas of the Kennedy Center and Georgetown waterfront, especially magical during cherry blossom season.
dont_miss: The hotel's private entrance to the exclusive Occidental Grill, a hidden speakeasy-style restaurant favored by senators and lobbyists. Also, explore the nearby Treasury Building's secret underground tunnels (public tours available), and catch a performance at the Kennedy Center, just a 5-minute walk away.
pros: Prime downtown location near major attractions and monuments
Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and attention to detail
Elegant rooms with luxury amenities and marble bathrooms
Full-service spa and well-equipped fitness center
cons: Busy downtown location with urban traffic and noise
